The '''Palace Courtyard''', also known as the '''Grand Plaza''', was a large annex to the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Royal Palace]] at the end of [[Palace Plaza/Legends|Palace Plaza]] in the [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] capital city, [[Theed/Legends|Theed]].

==History==
Following the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] ordered the construction of the courtyard to replace the buildings destroyed during the Federation's attack. Constructed at the end of [[Palace Plaza/Legends|Palace Plaza]] and the start of the city's [[Main Boulevard|main boulevard]], the courtyard buildings consisted of several large dome structures and a large arcing corridor which curved toward the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Royal Palace]].<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>

Following Amidala's term as queen, she was appointed [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] by her successor, Queen [[Jamillia/Legends|Jamillia]], and took up residence in an office within the Courtyard annex. From here the career politician fretted over the increase in rioting in the city. From her window in the complex she could see several incidents of migrant workers staging protests in the Courtyard to raise awareness of their poor working conditions. While forcibly removed by the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] each time, Amidala's security personnel continued to worry for the senator's safety remaining in the Courtyard complex. In the following weeks, Amidala returned from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] after escaping an [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempt on her life. Arriving by [[Airbus/Legends|airbus]] to the Courtyard, Amidala retired to her residence until her meeting with the Queen soon there after.<ref name="AOTCn">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref>

==Layout==
A massive complex constructed over a ruined portion of the city, the Courtyard complex consisted of two distinct structures; the hemispherical courtyard colonnade which framed the courtyard plaza and the large domed structures making up the bulk of the government offices. Along the base of the colonnade were several [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] friezes depicting some of the planet's greatest philosophers and artists. The courtyard was filled with trees, fountains, and a shallow moat crossed by many hump-backed bridges. With a The diameter of six hundred meters, its walkways were often used for royal occasions and ceremonies.<ref name="The Official Star Wars Fact File 80">{{FactFile|80|NAB 31-32|Naboo &ndash; Theed Grand Plaza}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Theed_spaceport.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The palace Courtyard is visible in front of the Palace in this image.]]
In [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], the courtyard was shown to be directly linked to a building complex that might be the Royal Palace from the side.<ref name="AOTC" /> The comic book [[Star Wars: Episode II — Attack of the Clones (comic series)|adapation]] of ''Star Wars Episode II'' even explicitely stated that the Courtyard was located "just outside the Royal Palace."<ref name="AOCC">[[Star Wars: Episode II — Attack of the Clones (comic series)|''Star Wars: Episode II — Attack of the Clones'' comic adaptation]]</ref> When the [[original trilogy]] was released in [[Star Wars Trilogy (DVD)|DVD format]] in [[2004]], shots of the Palace Plaza were inserted in the ending sequence of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], confirming that the Courtyard did not replace the Palace Plaza as some believed.<ref name="Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi">{{Film|VI}}</ref> In the [[2005]] movie [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']], the courtyard opens its two arms towards the Palace Plaza, and is not part of the Palace proper.<ref name="ROS">{{Film|III}}</ref> 

Footage of the Plaza was filmed at the Plaza de España in Seville.
